stats.text:
The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful.

***Divine Strike.*** The extra damage of your Divine Strike increases to 2d8.

***Potent Spellcasting.*** When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself, granting a number of {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.
